prompt: A gaunt mind-mage in deep sapphire robes stands at left in side profile facing east, one hand raised with fingers splayed, taut threads of glowing cerulean psychic energy running from each fingertip across the frame to the skull of a hulking gray-skinned ogre brute at right. The ogre hangs slack like a marionette, knees buckling, both arms dangling, its eyes blown out to blank glowing blue, its crude iron club slipping from its fingers. The only source of light is the cold blue mind-magic between them. The background is a dim stone dungeon hall.

Close on the face and shoulders of a gray-skinned armored ogre warrior, frozen mid-stride, with a spectral clawed hand made of pure cold cerulean psychic light clamped fully over its skull, fingers of light gripping the temples. The ogre eyes flare into blank glowing blue, its jaw slack, its own greatsword arm going limp and the blade dropping. The only source of light is the blue psychic grip on its head. The background is a smoky battlefield at dusk.

Two figures on a dusk battlefield, both fully visible. At right a robed mind-sorcerer in dark blue reaches out an open hand pouring cold cerulean light. At left an armored human soldier kneels, just seized, his body turning away from a fallen torn banner behind him to face the sorcerer, his eyes washed blank glowing blue, his face slack and obedient, his sword lowered. The only source of light is the blue psychic tether arcing from the sorcerer hand to the soldier head. The background is a ruined battlefield under a cold night sky.

The soldier hangs limp like a marionette, head lolling, knees half-buckled, eyes washed blank glowing blue, his lowered sword dangling. The only light source is the cold blue mind-magic. The background is a ruined battlefield with a fallen banner.
